_about: How the greenhouse's heat and CO2 demand enter the optimisation. The two penalties are solver devices, not prices: a large cost per unit not delivered, so the optimiser leaves demand unmet only when no block can cover it. A size that leaves demand unmet is reported and not chosen.
penalty_note: in the market's currency, far above any real cost of heat or CO2, so they never compete with them; they only keep the optimisation solvable when a block is too small
